name: Zig recreation of the kilo text editor tutorial

mentions.name: Zig recreation of the kilo text editor tutorial
mentions.description: A guide that recreates the kilo 'Build Your Own Text Editor' tutorial in Zig. Written as a self-learning exercise and shared online, with the hope that readers will improve it by posting issues or forking the project.
mentions.source_excerpt: I'm trying to recreate https://viewsourcecode.org/snaptoken/kilo/ but in Zig, will probably have to face shit metric ton of hate after finishing it due to probably some mistakes and sharing them online in form of a guide, but I'm doing it to learn myself
